author: The GNU nano developers, badge port

bundled.name: Badge port (start script, terminal entry, fork stub)

description:
Edit text files on the badge: notes, configuration files, scripts. GNU
nano shows its main short-cuts at the bottom of the screen: Ctrl+S
saves, Ctrl+X closes, Ctrl+W searches, Ctrl+K cuts a line and Ctrl+U
pastes it, Ctrl+G shows the help.

From the menu it starts on a new file on the SD card; Files opens text
files with it (.txt, .md, .conf, .sh, .py, .json and more). In a shell
(serial console or SSH) "nano file" edits in your own terminal, at full
width, with syntax colours for many languages.

The logo key closes it; unsaved text is then kept in a file with
".save" added to its name. Your own settings go in nanorc in the app's
config folder. Running a command from nano (Ctrl+T) is not possible on
the badge, and the spell checker is left out. Plain ASCII and Latin-1
only: no UTF-8.
